definitions.rationale: Unconditionally expands the proof-only name charLoopBody to the exact MPY statement tree for the source loop body; it defines a named proof term and is not an execution rule.
definitions.text:
rule charLoopBody =>
    If(Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("==", Str(" "))),
      If(BoolOp("and",
           Compare(Name("count"), CmpOp("==", Name("n"))),
           Compare(Name("word"), CmpOp("!=", Str("")))),
        Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), Name("word")))
        .Stmts,
        .Stmts)
      Assign(Name("word"), Str(""))
      Assign(Name("count"), Int(0))
      .Stmts,
      Assign(Name("word"), BinOp("+", Name("word"), Name("ch")))
      If(Compare(Name("ch"), CmpOp("not in", Str("aeiouAEIOU"))),
        Assign(Name("count"),
          BinOp("+", Name("count"), Int(1)))
        .Stmts,
        .Stmts)
      .Stmts)
    .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Unconditionally expands afterCharLoop to the exact final conditional-append and return statement tree, so it is a named-term definition rather than an operational semantic rule.
definitions.text:
rule afterCharLoop =>
    If(BoolOp("and",
         Compare(Name("count"), CmpOp("==", Name("n"))),
         Compare(Name("word"), CmpOp("!=", Str("")))),
      Expr(Call(Attribute(Name("result"), "append"), Name("word")))
      .Stmts,
      .Stmts)
    Return(Name("result"))
    .Stmts

definitions.rationale: Defines selectWordsBody by composing the exact initialization statements, loop term, and post-loop term used in the proof.
definitions.text:
rule selectWordsBody =>
    Assign(Name("result"), ListExpr(.Exprs))
    Assign(Name("word"), Str(""))
    Assign(Name("count"), Int(0))
    Assign(Name("ch"), Str(""))
    For(Name("ch"), Name("s"), charLoopBody)
    afterCharLoop

definitions.rationale: Defines the flushSelected count-mismatch branch: no word is selected and the accumulator is returned unchanged.
definitions.text:
rule flushSelected(A:ValSeq, _WORD:IntSeq, COUNT:Int, N:Int) => A
    requires COUNT =/=Int N
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the flushSelected equal-count, empty-word branch, which returns the accumulator without creating an empty output word.
definitions.text:
rule flushSelected(A:ValSeq, .IntSeq, COUNT:Int, N:Int) => A
    requires COUNT ==Int N
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the flushSelected equal-count, nonempty-word branch by appending that word to the accumulated ValSeq.
definitions.text:
rule flushSelected(A:ValSeq, WORD:IntSeq, COUNT:Int, N:Int)
    => valSeqConcat(A, vCons(str(WORD), .ValSeq))
    requires COUNT ==Int N andBool notBool (WORD ==K .IntSeq)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines selectScan as the composition of the scan accumulator, final word, final count, and final flush summaries.
definitions.text:
rule selectScan(S:IntSeq, N:Int, WORD:IntSeq, COUNT:Int, A:ValSeq)
    => flushSelected(
         scanAccum(S, N, WORD, COUNT, A),
         wordAfter(S, WORD),
         countAfter(S, COUNT),
         N)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the scanAccum base case on an empty remaining character sequence by returning the accumulated selected words.
definitions.text:
rule scanAccum(.IntSeq, _N:Int, _WORD:IntSeq, _COUNT:Int, A:ValSeq)
    => A
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the delimiter and count-mismatch scanAccum recurrence: discard the current word, reset its count, and recurse on the tail.
definitions.text:
rule scanAccum(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), N:Int, _WORD:IntSeq,
                 COUNT:Int, A:ValSeq)
    => scanAccum(R, N, .IntSeq, 0, A)
    requires C ==Int 32 andBool COUNT =/=Int N
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the delimiter, equal-count, empty-current-word scanAccum recurrence, resetting state without appending an empty word.
definitions.text:
rule scanAccum(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), N:Int, .IntSeq,
                 COUNT:Int, A:ValSeq)
    => scanAccum(R, N, .IntSeq, 0, A)
    requires C ==Int 32 andBool COUNT ==Int N
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the delimiter, equal-count, nonempty-current-word scanAccum recurrence by appending the word, resetting state, and recursing.
definitions.text:
rule scanAccum(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), N:Int,
                 WORD:IntSeq, COUNT:Int, A:ValSeq)
    => scanAccum(
         R, N, .IntSeq, 0,
         valSeqConcat(
           A, vCons(str(WORD), .ValSeq)))
    requires C ==Int 32 andBool COUNT ==Int N
      andBool notBool (WORD ==K .IntSeq)
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the non-space vowel scanAccum recurrence: extend the current word, leave the consonant count unchanged, and consume one character.
definitions.text:
rule scanAccum(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), N:Int, WORD:IntSeq,
                 COUNT:Int, A:ValSeq)
    => scanAccum(
         R, N, seqConcat(WORD, iCons(C, .IntSeq)), COUNT, A)
    requires C =/=Int 32
      andBool strContains(
        iCons(C, .IntSeq), strToCodes("aeiouAEIOU"))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the non-space non-vowel scanAccum recurrence: extend the current word, increment the consonant count, and consume one character.
definitions.text:
rule scanAccum(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), N:Int, WORD:IntSeq,
                 COUNT:Int, A:ValSeq)
    => scanAccum(
         R, N, seqConcat(WORD, iCons(C, .IntSeq)),
         COUNT +Int 1, A)
    requires C =/=Int 32
      andBool notBool strContains(
        iCons(C, .IntSeq), strToCodes("aeiouAEIOU"))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the wordAfter base case: with no remaining characters, the current word is the final word.
definitions.text:
rule wordAfter(.IntSeq, WORD:IntSeq) => WORD
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the wordAfter delimiter recurrence by resetting the current word and recursing on the remaining characters.
definitions.text:
rule wordAfter(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), _WORD:IntSeq)
    => wordAfter(R, .IntSeq)
    requires C ==Int 32
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the wordAfter non-delimiter recurrence by concatenating the character to the current word and consuming it.
definitions.text:
rule wordAfter(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), WORD:IntSeq)
    => wordAfter(R, seqConcat(WORD, iCons(C, .IntSeq)))
    requires C =/=Int 32
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the countAfter base case: with no remaining characters, the current count is final.
definitions.text:
rule countAfter(.IntSeq, COUNT:Int) => COUNT
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the countAfter delimiter recurrence by resetting the count to zero and consuming the delimiter.
definitions.text:
rule countAfter(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), _COUNT:Int)
    => countAfter(R, 0)
    requires C ==Int 32
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the countAfter non-space vowel recurrence, which consumes the character without changing the count.
definitions.text:
rule countAfter(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), COUNT:Int)
    => countAfter(R, COUNT)
    requires C =/=Int 32
      andBool strContains(
        iCons(C, .IntSeq), strToCodes("aeiouAEIOU"))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the countAfter non-space non-vowel recurrence, which consumes the character and increments the count.
definitions.text:
rule countAfter(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), COUNT:Int)
    => countAfter(R, COUNT +Int 1)
    requires C =/=Int 32
      andBool notBool strContains(
        iCons(C, .IntSeq), strToCodes("aeiouAEIOU"))
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the charAfter base case: when the suffix is empty, the previously stored loop character remains final.
definitions.text:
rule charAfter(.IntSeq, OLD:IntSeq) => OLD
    [simplification]

definitions.rationale: Defines the charAfter recurrence by storing the current one-character string and consuming one input character.
definitions.text:
rule charAfter(iCons(C:Int, R:IntSeq), _OLD:IntSeq)
    => charAfter(R, iCons(C, .IntSeq))
    [simplification]
